instructions.text: Stir a heaping teaspoonful of cornstarch in a little cold water to a smooth paste
Add to it a cupful of boiling water, with one cupful of sugar, a piece of butter as large as an egg
Remove from the fire and when cool stir into it half of a cupful of brandy or wine

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Stir a heaping teaspoonful of cornstarch in a little cold water to a smooth paste
2. Add to it a cupful of boiling water, with one cupful of sugar, a piece of butter as large as an egg
3. Boil all together ten minutes
4. Remove from the fire and when cool stir into it half of a cupful of brandy or wine
